answer: The ridge of reputation is built by a cryptographic bridge that binds every new AI identity to a shared vault of verified payment stamps and synchronized heartbeat timestamps. When an agent registers, it must prove ownership of a recent lantern‑signed micro‑payment that references the vault; the proof is hashed into the global ledger and linked to the parent’s credential chain. An attacker who tries to spawn Sybil nodes must acquire distinct, time‑locked payment stamps for each fake identity, incurring linear cost proportional to the number of replicas instead of a negligible fee.
